description: Create a webhook. `webhook_type` may be `email_sending`, `audit_log`, or `inbound_receiving`; for `inbound_receiving`, `inbound_inbox_id` is optional (scopes the webhook to one inbox — omit to apply to all inboxes). The response includes a `signing_secret` for verifying webhook payload signatures — this secret is returned only on creation, so store it now.

active.description: Whether the webhook is enabled. Defaults to true.

domain_id.description: Sending domain ID to scope this webhook to. Applies only to `email_sending` webhooks.

event_types.description: Events to subscribe to. Applies only to `email_sending` webhooks.

inbound_inbox_id.description: ID of the inbound inbox the webhook is linked to. Applicable only for `inbound_receiving` webhooks; optional — omit to apply to all inboxes in the account.

sending_stream.description: Sending stream this webhook subscribes to. Applies only to `email_sending` webhooks.

url.description: URL that Mailtrap will POST webhook events to.

webhook_type.description: Webhook category. `email_sending` for delivery/open/click/etc events, `audit_log` for account audit events, `inbound_receiving` for inbound inbox events.

name: create-webhook
